name: Bottom sheet
looksLike: panel that slides up from the bottom of the screen
mobile menu that rises from the bottom
card with a little handle bar at the top that you can drag down
definition: A panel that slides up from the bottom edge, common on mobile for actions, filters, or details. Often has a drag handle and can be swiped away.
whenToUse: Filters and sort options on phones
Detail previews such as a map pin card

notConfusedWith.difference: Slides in from the side instead of the bottom.

prompts.short: Add a bottom sheet with a drag handle. Swipe down or tap outside to close.
prompts.detailed: Add a mobile bottom sheet that slides up from the bottom with a drag handle, rounded top corners, and a dimmed backdrop. Support swipe-down and backdrop tap to close, cap its height at 85vh with internal scroll, and respect the safe-area inset.

reactTailwind: <div className="fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto rounded-t-2xl bg-white p-4 pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)] shadow-2xl">
<div className="mx-auto mb-3 h-1.5 w-10 rounded-full bg-gray-300" />

a11yNotes: Provide a close button as well as the swipe gesture
Trap focus while it is open
Use the dialog role and give it a name
